PPR (tonnes carbon) = annual landings × SPPR ÷ 9, using all sources. Model coefficients, trophic levels and taxon mappings are held fixed across years; missing taxa are excluded.

Unidentified catch uses the selected method’s own SPPR, including its existing mappings. Only explicit residual labels are classified; named genera and families are retained unless their catch label or common name explicitly says unidentified / NEI. See Coverage and sources for the exact list and classifier.

Shading shows hypothetical discard-routing scenarios on the same landings, with the same NPP denominator when displayed. The annual discard fraction comes from the catch data; uniform allocation within each source model is an assumption. This is not a confidence interval. Missing or invalid responses leave gaps; a routing-invariant reference does not establish zero ecological uncertainty.
